Pernille Aaen Sloth is an epidemiologist affiliated with SundK (Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut) [^src1]. She serves as a member of the [[styregruppen-for-danibd|Styregruppen for DANIBD]], the steering committee for the Danish National Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Disease [^src1]. Her position on the committee highlights her professional role in data analysis and quality development within the Danish national clinical quality databases [^src1]. 

The steering committee is an interdisciplinary and regional governance body comprising physicians, nursing leaders, patient representatives, and experts from Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut [^src1]. This group provides the institutional framework for the database's operations, overseeing methodological validity, coverage assessments (such as validating >90% coverage against regional databases), and quality benchmarking in Danish IBD care [^src1]. Within this context, Sloth's epidemiological expertise from SundK contributes directly to the committee's oversight of national health registries and clinical quality indicators [^src1].
